name: Wizardblade
text: WIZAROBLADE Weapon While carrying this item, you may use this sword to channel energy into a magical attack that targets an object, wizard, or creature. You may discard 1 Magic card to deal magical damage equal to the discarded Magic card's energy value. Wizardblade deals 1 crack per point of damage you inflict (rather than 1 crack per 3 points of damage).

name: Slow Death
text: Slow Death Curse Curse target wizard to suffer a lingering death. While this spell lasts, target wizard suffers 1 magical damage each time he draws a card. The target is not forced to draw cards. This spell only counts as your attack on the turn it is cast.

name: Invisible
text: INVISIBLE You become invisible. While this spell lasts, roll a die each time you are attacked. You evade the attack on a result of 2-4. When attacked, you may cast this spell as a counter.

name: Pick Lock

name: Seal Door
text: Seal Door Create a seal on target door. The door cannot be unlocked or opened by anyone, but it may still be destroyed. 2
